User.title: User
User.description: A user of the InfantIA application, typically a parent.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the user (from Firebase Auth).

photoURL.description: The URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user was created.

Child.title: Child
Child.description: A child belonging to a user.

userId.description: The UID of the parent user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the child record was created.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: A learning profile result for a specific child, generated from a quiz.

userId.description: The UID of the parent user.

childId.description: The ID of the child this profile belongs to.

answers.description: Map of question IDs to answer values (1–4).

scores.description: Normalized dimension scores (0–100) for each learning dimension.

primaryProfileId.description: ID of the dominant learning profile.

secondaryProfileId.description: ID of the secondary learning profile, if any.

confidence.description: Confidence level of the profile result.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

scoringVersion.description: Version of the scoring algorithm used.

/children/{childId}.description: Stores child records. A user can have multiple children.

/profiles/{profileId}.description: Stores learning profile results. A child can have multiple profiles over time.
